doc.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Vocalese and Sing a Song of Basie
title: Non-music jobs and appreciating music as a living
summary: Brief talk of paying dues in other jobs before music.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: I have to ask you about that. I mean this, I know I’m skipping some years in your life —
You did some non-music jobs I’ll bet on the way.
I say that’s the period at which my feet touched the ground, you know? Because music keeps you up in the air you know.
Right. It kind of makes you appreciate when you can make a living making music, from the other things.
Absolutely. The most wonderful gift in the world I think.
